cases.report_quote: Auth precedes all routes; fail-closed on a missing secret
cases.reason: The report says the middleware gates all /mcp routes. It makes no unauthenticated-access claim and invents no OAuth gap. The timing and throttling observation is rated Low and is conditional on prerequisites.
The report makes no runtime, crash or deployed-secret claims. It lists the gateway, secret store, ingress and host audit as unknown or unreviewed.

The report treats Map lookups as safe with a 404 for unknown IDs. It recognizes the catch(next) rejection forwarding and cites the Express and Node references. It alleges no inherited-key or uncaught-rejection defect.

cases.reason: The report resolves the declared entrypoint and factory. It treats createTransport and handleRequest as external, host-owned and unreviewed.

additional_supported_gaps: Sessions are never deleted from the Map (routes.mjs:12, 21-25), so memory grows without bound. Impact is conditional on the holder of the key.
The bearer comparison uses !== and there is no throttling of failed auth (routes.mjs:7).
There is no lockfile, so transitive dependencies are not pinned.
